header.name: Galaxy Sun V05
header.description: Galaxy Sun, increment 5: one scale (1 AU = 120 in). The Sun drifts at its true speed, 230 km/s (about 5,800 in per year), and the four planets go round it on their true orbits. Each planet's trail is a row of loops, because the drift is much faster than a planet's loop. The galactic arms are removed.
